title: Gray Pleated Skirt & Charm Bag Street
prompt: An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair stands on a cobblestone street outside a café with flower boxes. She wears a gray cardigan with a white collar and a pale gray bow at the neck, with a black pleated mini skirt and tall black platform knee-high boots. A black shoulder bag carries three plush bear charms. Gold drop earrings and a gold necklace. Her expression is warm, with a soft smile. Bright, warm daylight, a palette of charcoal, white, and black. Playful and polished, in the style of a European street-style photo.
workingNotes:
- The plush bear charms and bow collar are the playful details.
- Keep the café and cobblestones for a Parisian street setting.
